label: Tanzil Hafs Quran text for Search analysis
sourceAvailability: Search requires a committed normalized Hafs/Tanzil source at data/normalized/search/tanzil/hafs.json, produced by scripts/data/search/tanzil/import.mjs from Tanzil numbered Uthmani and simple-clean text. Search packs carry source id, build input digest, attribution, and update-link metadata.
transformedDataNotes: Used as the deterministic Search corpus only. Reader Qalun/Qaloon text is reached only through explicit Open in Read mapping when the Reader is using Qalun/Qaloon.

label: Bridges translation/context Search lane
sourceAvailability: QUL resource metadata and normalized Bridges input identify the approved source. Search labels this lane as source-backed indexed context, not tafsir.
transformedDataNotes: Tokenized for translation/context lookup only; no generated explanation or tafsir is produced.

label: Quranic Arabic Corpus morphology 0.4

licenseDecision.requiredNotice: Search morphology uses Quranic Arabic Corpus morphology 0.4 by Kais Dukes under GNU GPL terms and the upstream terms of use.

sourceAvailability: The approved QAC 0.4 source is committed verbatim at data/normalized/search/qac/quranic-corpus-morphology-0.4.txt with the upstream copyright block preserved. The official QAC download page remains the source of truth for updates.
transformedDataNotes: Morphology-derived Search outputs retain the QAC source id, accepted checksum, GPL notice metadata, and Hafs-source analysis warnings. QAC cites Tanzil compatibility, but QAC remains the morphology source and is not the Search text corpus.
